items.title: Amazon reports strong profits and net sales for Q2, fueled by robust growth in cloud computing unit
items.summary: Amazon delivered strong profits and net sales during its fiscal second quarter, helped by surging growth in its prominent cloud computing unit.  The e-commerce and technology company said Thursday that sales in its cloud computing unit called AWS rose 37% during the April-June period, faster than the 28% clip in the previous quarter and marking the fastest rate of growth in 18 quarters.  In a statement released Thursday, Amazon's CEO and president Andy Jassy said AWS is “booming” and noted that its AI and chips businesses each eclipsed run rates of more than $25 billion.
